description.value: La Brasserie is a casual all-day restaurant on Whistler's pedestrian Village Stroll, serving a European-bistro inspired menu that includes Eggs Benedict, cheese fondue, and rotating cocktail specials. Operating on a strict first-come, first-served basis with no reservations, it offers a relaxed drop-in dining option in the heart of Whistler Village. Its central location on the Stroll makes it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the area.

No bike-specific amenities (racks, charging, Wi-Fi, refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, leaving all required and most optional criteria at null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
